bolshevikmob55: Emil "Lucky" Bolshevikmob came from Dunmarrow, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.

Emil "Lucky" Bolshevikmob washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Emil "Lucky" Bolshevikmob folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Dorian Sucio (Concord) shouted a challenge across to Emil "Lucky" Bolshevikmob (Hegemony) at the Bone Quarry. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Emil "Lucky" Bolshevikmob worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Emil "Lucky" Bolshevikmob. The men named it the Judge and said it had chosen him.
the Judge the crow follows Emil "Lucky" Bolshevikmob along the trench now. When the Judge flies off, men duck. They are usually right to.
Somebody in T-F22 wanted to shoot the Judge for the pot. Emil "Lucky" Bolshevikmob stood in front of the rifle. The matter has been dropped.

Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Rafael "Smokes" Hobbybunker crossed it, Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft fired. Rafael "Smokes" Hobbybunker was grazed. After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft helped stack spare sandbags at Q-F14. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft. The men named it the Judge and said it had chosen him.
Zeno Hammerthyste of the Hegemony lost a harmonica in no man's land at Verdel Ridge. Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft of the Concord found it and has been learning the enemy's songs on it.
Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft fired at the enemy dawn watch from Q-F14. Dorian Borgia was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
Wendel Itzwill and Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Ulrich Felix was grazed.
c10ud_b3rry3.0: Edmund "Smokes" Rry stepped off the supply cart at S-F9 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.
One of the first hundred, Edmund "Smokes" Rry was given the First Wave ribbon. He wrapped the accompanying paper against the damp.

Edmund "Smokes" Rry dreamt of missing a train. Waking up here seemed an unreasonable punishment for it. Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Edmund "Smokes" Rry shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Edmund "Smokes" Rry offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once.
Edmund "Smokes" Rry fired at a movement across the wire at S-F9. The man went down: Emil Galvanooooo, grazed.

At Lantern Hill, Edmund "Smokes" Rry and Leopold Fwtx exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into S-F9. Edmund "Smokes" Rry has learned to walk bent double.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Edmund "Smokes" Rry said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.
Edmund "Smokes" Rry taught Nils Zczc to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.

Edmund "Smokes" Rry was hit through the stomach at S-F9. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Gideon Jimmysparrow of the Hegemony (@jimmysparrow17). Edmund "Smokes" Rry was killed outright at S-F9, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Gideon Jimmysparrow of the Hegemony (@jimmysparrow17).

Roland Rry asked about Edmund "Smokes" Rry on arriving at S-F9. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. Number 84 on the early rolls: Roland Rry. The First Wave ribbon arrived with instructions about where to sew it and no needle.
Roland Rry fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Arno Toastyy was grazed.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Roland Rry wrote to a mother who sets a place for him at every meal that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Fresh from training, Roland Rry still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Silas Zdsh, badly wounded. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Roland Rry watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Roland Rry cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.
Roland Rry wrote to a mother who sets a place for him at every meal. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.
Roland Rry and Zeno "Shadow" Maximus carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
Roland Rry had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Valentin "Saint" Prestonspear crossed it, Roland Rry fired. Valentin "Saint" Prestonspear was grazed.

Roland Rry counted the steps of the Hegemony sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Roland Monster never saw the shovel coming. (@gunpla_monster) Roland Rry threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Konrad "Ash" Sapino was down and screaming for a medic. (@lorenzo_sapino_)
daami_nt: After 9 days of war, R-C8 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Konrad Daami.

Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Casimir Jcsv stood up to sing louder, and Konrad Daami fired. Casimir Jcsv was badly wounded. The singing stopped. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Konrad Daami read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Konrad Daami spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open. Konrad Daami got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 639. The men who came later will ask about it. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Konrad Daami looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Konrad Daami tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
Konrad Daami got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.
Konrad Daami dreamt he was back in Tannenfeld, working as a brewer. He woke up and said nothing all morning.
Konrad Daami fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Ulrich "Bones" Swan was badly wounded, and that rifle did not fire again tonight.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Konrad Daami said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.
eurotrashhhhhh: The old hands of S-S14 have been here since Day 1. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh has been here since Day 7. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

Two carrying parties met in the narrow trench. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh helped work out how an ammunition box and a very large kettle could pass each other. A letter from home reached Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh before dusk. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh read it twice and slept a little easier. Now serving as a signaller, Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony. A letter from home reached Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh before dusk. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh read it twice and slept a little easier.

The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again. A letter from home reached Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh before dusk. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh and Florian Tetanusmaxxe compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house. A letter from home reached Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh before dusk. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh read it twice and slept a little easier. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 499. The men who came later will ask about it. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh held the mirror while Konrad Summer shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments. A letter from home reached Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh before dusk. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh reached up to fix a sandbag at S-S14 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Marek "Brick" Buddy of the Concord (@big_fat_buddy). A letter from home reached Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh before dusk. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh read it twice and slept a little easier.

Back on the fire step at S-S14. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign. A letter from home reached Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh before dusk. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh carried duckboards up from the rear all night. His shoulders are a map of splinters. A letter from home reached Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh before dusk. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh and Emil "Ghost" Fuck tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh found a letter on the fire step, left by the runner. Dorian "Owl" Eurotrashhhh read it while the kettle boiled.
geraldkisner: Severin Geraldkisner was a blacksmith in Old Harrow until the posters went up. He came to P-F1 with a tin whistle, and within a day the whole squad knew that he draws portraits of the men in the margins of letters.

The shelling stopped while Severin Geraldkisner was counting the seconds between hits. He kept counting anyway, and waited a long time before moving. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Severin Geraldkisner wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Severin Geraldkisner was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at P-F1. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Konrad "Button" Jasierralta of the Hegemony (@jasierralta). Severin Geraldkisner fired at a movement across the wire at P-F1. The man went down: Edmund "Ghost" Sealy, grazed.
Severin Geraldkisner walked back up the communication trench to P-F1, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Severin Geraldkisner checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more.
Severin Geraldkisner fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Edmund "Ghost" Sealy, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Matthias Fejobo, grazed. Severin Geraldkisner cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. Two shots, one miss. The second found Nils Amourika, gravely wounded. Severin Geraldkisner cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
goog_the_bearer_of_goggles: The old hands of Q-F21 have been here since Day 1. Walter Goggles has been here since Day 10. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.

During a lull at the Chalk Pits, Walter "Mole" Dobremateico called across from the Concord line. Walter Goggles answered from the Hegemony side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Walter Goggles helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Walter Goggles remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.
Walter Goggles had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Karel Littlerattae was badly wounded.
Walter Goggles had Yann Hopper of the Concord in the sights at Lantern Hill for a long second. Yann Hopper was lighting a pipe. Walter Goggles let the match burn all the way down.
Walter Goggles was hit in the hip at Q-F21. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Gustav Suppahneggah of the Concord (@suppahneggah).
Walter Goggles lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.
hellcat34106: They issued Tobias Hellcat a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a dented harmonica in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

Tobias Hellcat fired at a movement across the wire at S-F15. The man went down: Benedikt Jakubwilkuu, grazed. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Tobias Hellcat stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Tobias Hellcat borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.

Teodor "Brick" Vuminhtri of the Concord spotted Tobias Hellcat of the Hegemony repairing a parapet at Calvary Farm. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot. A letter from home reached Tobias Hellcat before dusk. Tobias Hellcat read it twice and slept a little easier.

Tobias Hellcat went out with the wiring party at S-F15. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. A letter from home reached Tobias Hellcat before dusk. Tobias Hellcat read it twice and slept a little easier. Tobias Hellcat walked the captured trenches of Hill 304 and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

A clear shot from S-F15. Tobias Hellcat grazed Jakub "Ash" Cocac and slid back down below the parapet. Tobias Hellcat raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F15. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Bram Archiegregor of the Concord (@archiegregorysmith). A letter from home reached Tobias Hellcat before dusk. Tobias Hellcat read it twice and slept a little easier.
Tobias Hellcat's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. A letter from home reached Tobias Hellcat before dusk. Tobias Hellcat read it twice and slept a little easier.

A round went through Tobias Hellcat's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman of the Concord (@killerdogman2010). A letter from home reached Tobias Hellcat before dusk. Tobias Hellcat read it twice and slept a little easier.

A round came through the loophole Tobias Hellcat was watching at S-F15 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Edmund Callmequeeno of the Concord (@callmequeenorea_). Tobias Hellcat looked over the parapet at S-F15 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Edmund Callmequeeno of the Concord (@callmequeenorea_).
Nils Hellcat had heard about Tobias Hellcat's courage. At S-F15, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Nils Hellcat only heard boots on the duckboards at S-F15, then nothing but pain. Raider: Quentin Tomishidk of the Concord (@tomishidk). Nils Hellcat is out of the worst of it. He sleeps most of the day, and the surgeon lets him. News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Nils Hellcat during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better. A letter from home reached Nils Hellcat before dusk. Nils Hellcat read it twice and slept a little easier.

For days Nils Hellcat was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle. The clerk counted the names twice. Nils Hellcat is number 141 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Victory at Grey Mill. Nils Hellcat let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Nils Hellcat closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
Nils Hellcat came off watch and could not say whether the last hour had felt long or short. He remembered every move in one patch of wire.

Nils Hellcat felt a hard tug at his hip at S-F15. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Florian Heffy of the Concord (@el.heffy000).
Nils Hellcat no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F15 and grazed Nils Hellcat's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Silas Charlieshort of the Concord (@charlieshort5.0).
i_cwit: On Day 10 Wendel "Smokes" Cwit took a post at U-F2 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He hates silence more than shelling, and the men liked him for it.

Wendel "Smokes" Cwit and Hugo "Lucky" Ritualforsam sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into U-F2. Wendel "Smokes" Cwit has learned to walk bent double.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Wendel "Smokes" Cwit. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
Wendel "Smokes" Cwit borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Wendel "Smokes" Cwit aimed a step ahead and fired: Yann Mustakimabdu, gravely wounded.
Someone in U-F2 asked Wendel "Smokes" Cwit about Lindenbruck. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted.
Wendel "Smokes" Cwit wrote to a teacher who said he would amount to nothing. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.

Felix "Mud" Summerton and Anselm Chandlerz cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button. A letter from home reached Felix "Mud" Summerton before dusk. Felix "Mud" Summerton read it twice and slept a little easier. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Felix "Mud" Summerton wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Isidor Ksie and Felix "Mud" Summerton made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure. A letter from home reached Felix "Mud" Summerton before dusk. Felix "Mud" Summerton read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix "Mud" Summerton cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt. A letter from home reached Felix "Mud" Summerton before dusk. Felix "Mud" Summerton read it twice and slept a little easier.
A shell landed close to P-F2. When the dust settled Felix "Mud" Summerton was still there, holding a pocket Bible with a hole in it, laughing without sound.
A splinter opened Felix "Mud" Summerton's cheek at P-F2. A medic stitched it on the spot and he was back on the fire step before the tea went cold.
Felix "Mud" Summerton's bandage soaked through twice in one night. The medic called the bearers before morning.
kahuna382000: The sergeant gave Roland Kahuna a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 10 or any other.

Someone asked Roland Kahuna to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached P-F6 with the rations. Roland Kahuna ate while listening to the revised orders.
The patrol came back one man at a time. Roland Kahuna held the gap open and counted until the corporal said that was everyone.
Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Henrik Alongcornfla stood up to sing louder, and Roland Kahuna fired. Henrik Alongcornfla was grazed. The singing stopped.
Roland Kahuna tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Roland Kahuna waited for that to change. When it did, Yann Donkay was badly wounded.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Roland Kahuna across the shin at P-F6. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Pavel Schizophreni of the Hegemony (@schizophrenicwizard). Roland Kahuna counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Ivo "Ash" Ashtheslowon was grazed.
ki11z3r6.0: Viktor Kizr left an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive behind in Northwick and came up the line with a tin of tobacco. The men noticed at once that he can fall asleep anywhere, instantly.

Viktor Kizr kept watch so that Cyril Bmx could sleep. Then Cyril kept watch so that Viktor could. Neither slept. Victory at Grey Mill. Viktor Kizr let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Viktor Kizr tried to fold a frozen groundsheet. It objected loudly enough to wake the next sleeper.
Viktor Kizr smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Pavel "Lucky" Tawt came out for a cup and was grazed.
Viktor Kizr lent Bram "Mud" Freaking a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.

Viktor Kizr had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Benedikt Dorno was badly wounded. Viktor Kizr felt a hard tug at his hip at Q-F3. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Back on the fire step at Q-F3. Viktor Kizr says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.

Norbert Kracun watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Norbert Kracun rejoined the squad at S-C6. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
Norbert Kracun washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation.

Tobias Kracun has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment.
landon59504: By the time Felix Landon reached R-F17, the war was 2 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Felix Landon watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Felix Landon raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F17. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Jakub "Brick" Ingfan of the Hegemony (@seal.ingfan).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Felix Landon is whole again, or near enough for the line.

Felix Landon spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection. From Hill 304 the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Felix Landon wrote to a teacher who said he would amount to nothing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Felix Landon asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.
A letter reached Felix Landon from Dunmarrow. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one.
Felix Landon dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Felix Landon's ear at R-F17 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Jakub "Brick" Ingfan of the Hegemony (@seal.ingfan).

Number 179. The men who came later will ask about it. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Felix Landon watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Frost on the wire made it sing in the wind. Felix Landon could not stop listening to it.
Felix Landon held the mirror while Yann Vylet shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
A parcel came for Felix Landon that was really meant for another soldier with the same surname. Inside: two knitted scarves. He put everything back and kept only the wrapping.

Felix Landon was carrying water up to R-F17 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Felix Landon did not. Shot by Jakub "Brick" Ingfan of the Hegemony (@seal.ingfan). The papers connected Albin Landon to Felix Landon. The men took longer to learn Albin Landon's own habits, but they made the effort.

Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.
Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp saw the glint of an enemy scope and fired first. The man behind it, Ulrich Porsche, was grazed.
Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp let three easy targets go by. The fourth was the one worth the risk. Ivo Littlesaint was gravely wounded.
Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp fired at a movement across the wire at R-F7. The man went down: Felix "Spark" Reiddemars, badly wounded.
n_a_m238: Marek Nam joined the replacements on Day 16. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
niko2kha: After 10 days of war, P-F21 had a place for everything. On Day 10, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Marek Kha.

Marek Kha borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. After the loss of Grey Mill, Marek Kha helped stack spare sandbags at P-F21. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Marek Kha felt a hard tug at his hip at P-F21. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Gideon Ztardvst of the Hegemony (@_ztardvst).
The wound on Marek Kha's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.

A bullet hit Marek Kha in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at P-F21. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Matthias Coop of the Hegemony (@dale.coop). Marek Kha fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Matthias Coop was grazed, and that rifle did not fire again tonight. Marek Kha was hit at P-F21 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Matthias Coop of the Hegemony (@dale.coop).
The papers connected Oskar Kha to Marek Kha. The men took longer to learn Oskar Kha's own habits, but they made the effort.
Across from P-F21, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Oskar Kha saw it. Tobias Countdooku was badly wounded.
The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At P-F21 they left Oskar Kha behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Matthias Coop of the Hegemony (@dale.coop).
Walter Kha took the same post at P-F21 where Oskar Kha stood. He found his father's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
propaganda_of_bengal: Roland "Bones" Bengal arrived with the Day 10 draft, carrying a child's drawing of a horse and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Roland "Bones" Bengal was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at U-F8. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Nils Reynolds of the Concord (@chase_reynolds_13). Roland "Bones" Bengal looked over the parapet at U-F8 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Nils Reynolds of the Concord (@chase_reynolds_13).

The papers say Walter Bengal. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Roland "Bones" Bengal's eyes. Nobody in U-F8 argues. Victory at Grey Mill. Walter Bengal let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Walter Bengal smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Rafael "Spark" Barba came out for a cup and was grazed. Two shots, one miss. The second found Albin Ilhanrae, badly wounded. Walter Bengal cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Walter Bengal changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
Walter Bengal (Hegemony) and Karel Servantofgod (Concord) spotted the same abandoned cart near Blackwater Canal. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was.
The new recruit kept closing both eyes to aim. Walter Bengal spent the afternoon helping until one eye stayed open.
On dawn watch at U-F8, Walter Bengal fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Leopold "Tin" Guy, now gravely wounded.
schizophreniawaffles: The old hands of T-F12 have been here since Day 1. Ulrich Schizophreni has been here since Day 9. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Ulrich Schizophreni wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Ulrich Schizophreni changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Ulrich Schizophreni did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Ulrich Schizophreni was found at the bottom of the trench at T-F12, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Cyril Connorboi of the Concord (@connorboi308). The bearers reached Ulrich Schizophreni at T-F12 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Cyril Connorboi of the Concord (@connorboi308).
The House of Schizophreni sent another. Albin "Shadow" Schizophreni, uncle of Ulrich Schizophreni, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
The trench wall shook against Albin "Shadow" Schizophreni's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Albin "Shadow" Schizophreni said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.

Albin "Shadow" Schizophreni borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'. A letter from home reached Albin "Shadow" Schizophreni before dusk. Albin "Shadow" Schizophreni read it twice and slept a little easier.

The Concord raiders were in and out in two minutes. At T-F12 they left Albin "Shadow" Schizophreni behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Tobias "Hollow" Evie of the Concord (@evie.sh207).
Matthias Schizophreni came to the front because his older brother Albin "Shadow" Schizophreni never came home. He carries a frozen apple.
szy_0204: Rafael Szy left his mother, who writes every Sunday behind in Port Abel and came up the line with a key to a house that is no longer there. The men noticed at once that he reads the same book over and over.

Rafael Szy raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-R1. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Dietrich "Button" Cake of the Concord (@lonnor_cake). Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Rafael Szy shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend. A letter from home reached Rafael Szy before dusk. Rafael Szy read it twice and slept a little easier.

A single shot from across the wire hit Rafael Szy in the thigh at R-R1. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Henrik Tobiasweighi of the Concord (@tobiasweighill). The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Rafael Szy did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Rafael Szy lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk. A letter from home reached Rafael Szy before dusk. Rafael Szy read it twice and slept a little easier.
Rafael Szy spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to R-R1.
A bullet hit Rafael Szy's belt buckle at R-R1 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Bram Briton of the Concord (@martin.briton).

A bullet hit Rafael Szy in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-R1. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Anselm Whispertooth of the Concord (@whispertooth).
A medic brought Rafael Szy half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real.
vilgot_bertilsson: Hugo Bertilsson came up with a draft of replacements on Day 15. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Hugo Bertilsson came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. Hugo Bertilsson spent the night on a stretcher in the trench behind the aid post. Every bed was taken. Hugo Bertilsson kept the new letter in a breast pocket all day, and touched the pocket now and then to check it was there.
zander.joseph2006: Leopold Joseph arrived with the Day 7 draft, carrying his brother's pocket watch and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
Leopold Joseph carried Konrad Cbour's rifle all the way up to the Hanging Bridge after Konrad twisted an ankle. Neither has said thank you. Neither needs to.
The cook's fire went out. Leopold Joseph relit it under his own coat and served stew that tasted of wool.
Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Leopold Joseph could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Leopold Joseph obtained a recipe for a batch of potato cakes. The instructions assume a kitchen, a steady fire and ingredients that do not arrive in sacks. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Leopold Joseph answered to number 482. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Leopold Joseph helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Leopold Joseph took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for.
Leopold Joseph counted the ladles in the pot against the men in the queue. The last serving took some careful scraping.
Leopold Joseph tried a small batch of a batch of potato cakes. The bottom burned before the middle cooked. The tasting committee ate the edges and requested patience.
Leopold Joseph repaired a collapsed wall of the trench at R-S4 with sandbags, boards and language not fit for letters home.
For the second attempt, Leopold Joseph raised the pot above the hottest part of the fire. The smell brought volunteers before help was requested.
